answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the basalt log exposes the live set and the onyx audit records each lapse. Keeping 36 aliases alive thus means 36 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the raven quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 645 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
